_verify: Painted at Prouts Neck, Maine (MFA Boston); the fish is usually described as halibut.

slides.headline: The fog is coming. Can he make it *back*?
A lone fisherman rows home across a cold, rough *sea*.
He turns his head and looks *back*.
Far away is the schooner he must *reach*.
And above it, a dark bank of *fog*.
His hands grip the oars. Every stroke *counts*.
His catch lies in the boat: a huge *halibut*.
Lines and gear crowd the small *boat*.
The bow lifts high on every *wave*.
The waves are rising, and the boat is *heavy*.
In fog, he could lose the ship *forever*.
Homer never shows the end. Does he make it *back*?
